hooks.command: test -f docs/loops/CURRENT.md && { echo '--- docs/loops/CURRENT.md ---'; cat docs/loops/CURRENT.md; } || true

input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("command",""))' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*|*'git push'*) bash scripts/dev/precommit-check.sh ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
test -f docs/loops/CURRENT.md && printf -- '- %s heartbeat\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" >> docs/loops/CURRENT.md || true
